#   Binary Defense Systems Artillery Threat Intelligence Feed and Banlist Feed
#   
#   A list of known attacker IP addresses detected by their Artillery honeypot
#   and monitoring platform. IPs in this feed have been observed actively
#   attacking Artillery sensors.
#   
#   Artillery is an open-source honeypot and endpoint monitoring tool that
#   detects port scanning, brute force attacks, and other malicious activity.
#   
#   This third-party blocklist is not maintained by ConfigServer; IPs are
#   sourced externally and not curated by us. We do however, validate the
#   blocklist to ensure that it only contains properly validated IP addresses,
#   and does not include any non-relevant or malicious data beyond the scope
#   of the source.
#   
#   Use at the administrator’s discretion based on risk tolerance and
#   environment requirements.
